cohort: The study included a random subsample of 2798 women with vertex, singleton pregnancies who labored, drawn from the 12-site Collaborative Perinatal Project (1959 to 1966).
finding: Maternal vitamin D status at <=26 weeks gestation was not associated with an increased risk of prolonged labor or operative delivery.
mod_finding: Maternal vitamin D status at <=26 weeks was not associated with the risk of primary cesarean delivery or instrumental delivery.
